key_finding: The report cited limited European epidemiology and an HTD estimate of 0.33 BRAF-altered pediatric LGG cases per 100,000 individuals aged 0 to 19 in EU member states.

status_in_jca: Used to identify and verify evidence base
key_finding: The report described systematic information retrieval and assessor review of HTD search strategy appropriateness.
ClinicalTrials.gov and other registry searches were documented, including a July 31 2025 ClinicalTrials.gov search.
MEDLINE/PubMed search strategy and query terms were documented with a July 31 2025 search date.
The HTD used a literature review, all clinical studies identified in the SLR, grey literature search, and expert ranking to identify prognostic and effect-modifying variables.
Assessors reported that available information did not establish whether the PV/EM identification process was comprehensive and noted that not all identified variables were adjusted.
The HTD submitted an unanchored MAIC of tovorafenib versus dabrafenib plus trametinib for PICO 5.
STC was discussed as an alternative but was not carried out because the ESS reduction trigger was not met.
The HTD attempted to construct external control arms using patient data outside clinical studies, but concluded that no fit-for-purpose reliable comparator data source was possible.
Generic and disease-specific HRQoL were requested in the assessment scope; patient/carer input noted no HRQoL results for Population 2 in FIREFLY-1.
Patient/carer input stated that excluding partial or mixed real-world comparator data limited relevance and highlighted missing quality-of-life, long-term, and real-world comparator evidence.
Assessors requested corrected safety analyses and comparable ORR analyses; the HTD provided corrected safety analyses and ORR analyses based on RANO-HGG criteria.
The HTD argued pooled Arm 1+2 analyses would require mixed SDV and non-SDV datasets; assessors did not agree this should prevent requested analyses.
